public_rationale: The qualification is material. This is an assessment of whether there is sufficient reason to attribute stable world representations, not an unqualified claim that no internal representations exist. Scoring a probe result as a contradiction would remove that qualification and supply a definition of stability. The next-word statement can be examined separately, but it does not make the combined assessment uniquely testable.
limitations: This does not endorse the inference from next-word prediction to an absence of world representations.
A narrower claim about a specified model and a defined form of stability could be assessed.
